description: Java entity class representing product availability details in an e-commerce system, including product info, quantity, availability date, region, shipping, and pricing.

classes.name: ProductAvailability
classes.description: Entity class for managing product availability, including quantity, date, region, shipping, and pricing details.

methods.name: defaultPrice
methods.description: Returns the default product price from the set of prices.

methods.name: getProductQuantity
methods.description: Gets the quantity of the product available.

methods.name: setProductQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product available.

methods.name: getProductDateAvailable
methods.description: Gets the date when the product becomes available.

methods.name: setProductDateAvailable
methods.description: Sets the date when the product becomes available.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Gets the region associated with the product availability.

methods.name: setRegion
methods.description: Sets the region associated with the product availability.

methods.name: getRegionVariant
methods.description: Gets the region variant.

methods.name: setRegionVariant
methods.description: Sets the region variant.

methods.name: getProductStatus
methods.description: Checks if the product is active.

methods.name: setProductStatus
methods.description: Sets the product's active status.

methods.name: getProductIsAlwaysFreeShipping
methods.description: Checks if the product always qualifies for free shipping.

methods.name: setProductIsAlwaysFreeShipping
methods.description: Sets whether the product always qualifies for free shipping.

methods.name: getProductQuantityOrderMin
methods.description: Gets the minimum order quantity.

methods.name: setProductQuantityOrderMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum order quantity.

methods.name: getProductQuantityOrderMax
methods.description: Gets the maximum order quantity.

methods.name: setProductQuantityOrderMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum order quantity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the entity ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the entity ID.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Gets the associated product.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the associated product.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Gets the set of product prices.

methods.name: setPrices
methods.description: Sets the set of product prices.
